company.value: Retool is an enterprise platform for building production-ready internal software, AI apps, workflows, and agents on connected business data with governance controls such as access controls and audit logging.

funding.value: Retool raised a $45M Series C2 round in July 2022 at a reported $3.2B valuation; the reported lead investors included Sequoia Capital, John and Patrick Collison, Nat Friedman, Elad Gil, Daniel Gross, and Caryn Marooney.

hiring_signals.value: Retool’s careers page listed 33 open roles across business operations, data science and analytics, engineering, product, professional services, sales, and sales development, among other functions.

Current openings include a Staff Product Manager, Automation; Senior Product Manager, Enterprise Platform; Software Engineer, Governance; and Software Engineer, Enterprise Expansion—signals of continued investment in automation, enterprise capabilities, and governance.

likely_use_case.value: Potential fit for governed SDR pre-call research automation: use AI workflows/agents to connect CRM and other business systems, synthesize account context, and retain auditability and role-based access. This is an inference from Retool’s stated workflow, agent, data-connection, and governance capabilities—not confirmation of its current SDR tooling or process.

deal_band.value: MID-MARKET to ENTERPRISE (tentative): Retool presents itself as an enterprise platform and reports 10,000+ teams using its products; the live hiring footprint also spans Sales Development and enterprise-focused product/engineering roles. Actual budget, SDR-seat count, and procurement scope are unverified.
